# Persistent U64 Watermark And CommitRank Experiment

Date: 2026-06-13

This ledger appends the post-watermark/CommitRank benchmark run for the native
`PersistentARTrieU64Compact` implementation. It does not replace the earlier
pgmcp artifacts `111` and `112`; those remain historical pre-alignment
measurements.

## Implementation Under Test

- `PersistentARTrieU64Compact<V, S>` uses
  `AtomicNodePtr<OverlayNode<U64Key<U64_CX_PREFIX_COMPACT>, V>>`.
- Durable writes append the data WAL record, publish the overlay root by CAS,
  append a `CommitRank`, and advance `CommittedWatermark`.
- Checkpointing records the committed-prefix `checkpoint_lsn` and retains WAL
  tail records for recovery.
- Checkpoint images use the u64 CX snapshot format, not the removed native
  bincode snapshot/WAL path.

## Command

```bash
PART_U64_FIXED_SAMPLES=1 cargo bench --features persistent-artrie --bench persistent_artrie_u64_native_benchmarks
```

The benchmark uses seeded time-series u64 sequences. Temporary benchmark
directories are created under `target/bench-scratch`, not `/tmp`.

## pgmcp Records

| Metric | Experiment | Hypothesis | Work item | Verdict |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| `lookup_ns_per_query` | 53 | 53 | `experiment-u64-compact-lookup-after-watermark-alignment-1b4e33` | accepted |
| `parallel_ns_per_read` | 54 | 54 | `experiment-u64-compact-parallel-read-write-latency-0a113e` | accepted |
| `checkpoint_bytes_per_entry` | 55 | 55 | `experiment-u64-compact-checkpoint-density-b2cb22` | accepted |

Raw benchmark output was also attached to pgmcp artifact `132`.

## Results

| Metric | Control | Treatment | Welch result |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Lookup latency | `455.352 ns/query` byte-encoded u64 | `357.248 ns/query` native prefix-4 | accepted, `p = 2.82e-35`, Cohen's `d = -3.87` |
| Parallel read latency with one writer | `204.304 ns/read` byte-encoded u64 | `148.347 ns/read` native prefix-4 | accepted, `p = 4.42e-9`, Cohen's `d = -1.24` |
| Checkpoint density | `469.759 bytes/entry` prefix-3 | `453.982 bytes/entry` prefix-4 | accepted, `p = 4.61e-127`, Cohen's `d = -89.00` |
| Checkpoint disk bytes | `1,585,249` byte-encoded u64 | `929,096` native prefix-4 | scalar observation, `41.39%` smaller |

Prefix-4 lookup was not statistically faster than prefix-3 lookup in this
registered run (`357.248 ns/query` versus `347.563 ns/query`, Welch
`p = 0.0639`). Prefix-4 remains the default because the registered storage
density hypothesis was accepted and native prefix-4 still beat the byte-encoded
u64 control on lookup and the concurrent reader/writer workload.
